text:
maya (partnerships): Heads up 1: CloudX wants a minimal "refkit-slim" deliverable for marketplace onboarding. They asked for a Terraform example, a tiny CI smoke test, and a partner-friendly README. Can we scope a 1-pager and a working example by Thu?

owen (cloud-eng): OK. Proposal: a single Terraform module that only does networking + a single small GPU instance + pulls a partner-provided container. Keep the module under `modules/refkit-slim` and examples/simple/. No model artifacts built in CI by default.

jess (solutions): For partners this needs to be copy-pasteable. Suggest examples/simple/aws.tf with a vars file and a comment block showing required secrets. Also include a baked-in healthcheck path: `/healthz` and `/v1/predict`.

rachel (security): Quick checklist: container image must be scanned (we can integrate partner image scan via `trivy` in GH Actions), minimal IAM scope, and a list of required KMS permissions if they opt-in to envelope encryption.

tom (pm): Can we include a small manifest file `marketplace.yaml` with fields: name, short_description, supported_clouds, arch, license, contact_email? Marketplace automation will pick it up.

deploy-bot: Preview build started: ci/refkit-slim/7 — will report results here.

owen (cloud-eng): Example main.tf for docs (examples/simple/main.tf):

```terraform
module "refkit_slim" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-refkits.git//modules/refkit-slim"
  cloud = var.cloud
  region = var.region
  image = var.image
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  skip_image_build = var.skip_image_build
}

output "service_endpoint" {
  value = module.refkit_slim.endpoint
}
```

jess (solutions): CI smoke plan for GH Actions: `plan -> apply (tiny infra) -> wait for /healthz -> POST /v1/predict with {"prompt":"hello"} -> assert status 200 and simple json -> terraform destroy`. Use a single retry loop for service readiness.

own (cloud-eng): We'll gate the smoke on a single SKU label (e.g., `gpu-small`). Add a flag `ci_allowed = true` so partner can opt-in to run CI in our repo.

rachel (security): Add `trivy` step and a policy check step (terraform `plan` output scanned against our least-privilege rules). I'll add a small policy template under `security/policies/refkit-slim.policy`.

tom (pm): Maya, can partnerships own the docs page text and the checklist for partner dry-run (screenshots, costs estimate, support SLAs)? I'd like to have the checklist ready before we invite CloudX.

maya (partnerships): Yep. I'll draft the partner-facing README with a short "how to run the smoke test" section, a minimal manifest example, and a one-page publish checklist. Will loop in docs and security.

jess (solutions): One more practical note: include `skip_image_build` boolean and `prebuilt_image` string var. If partner sets `prebuilt_image`, module will skip building and use that image. Saves CI time and avoids us storing partner artifacts.

own (cloud-eng): I'll open a PR with the module skeleton, example, and the GH Actions workflow `.github/workflows/refkit-smoke.yml`. Will include a matrix for `cloud: [aws, gcp]` initially, and leave OCI for follow-up.

maya (partnerships): Great. Timeline: PR by EOD Wed, partner dry-run next Tue. Thanks all :rocket:
